headline: Indian IT services posted solid top‑line growth with AI‑driven deals lifting margins for several firms.
summary: Revenue rose across the majority of the cohort, led by Coforge's 53.6% YoY surge and TCS's 15.4% increase. Profit growth was mixed; HCLTech and Coforge posted strong gains, while Infosys trimmed guidance and Persistent saw profit decline. AI revenue is becoming a material contributor, highlighted by TCS, HCLTech and Wipro. Guidance outlook is mixed, with Infosys cutting its FY27 growth target and HCLTech maintaining a modest outlook.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue and large‑deal wins are boosting top‑line growth for TCS, HCLTech and Wipro.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins expanded for TCS (24%) and Coforge (16%) but remained flat or slipped for Infosys and Wipro.

themes.title: Guidance volatility
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance, while HCLTech kept a modest range and Wipro introduced a short‑term outlook.
